services.name: Dinner and Dolphin Cruise | Bull River Marina in Partnership with Kelly Tours Gr
services.desc: Duration 1.5 Hours About Start your trip being transported from Downtown Savannah with Kelly Tours Gray Line to the incredible Erica Davis Low Country for a true Savannah restaurant experience. After dinner be transported to Bull River Marina where we will board the Bella boat and enjoy an amazing sunset cruise while looking for dolphins, shore birds, and other wildlife. Your Captain will tell you about the area and wildlife and our Savannah ecosystem all while taking in the amazing view of the salt marshes as the sun sets. Plan your trip Meet for Kelly Tours transport at 4:00 pm 223 Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd at least 15 minutes prior to tour time. We will not wait for late arrivals.

services.name: Little Tybee Eco Tours
services.desc: Duration 4 Hours About Neighboring the Wassaw Sound, Little Tybee Island is located just south of Tybee Island along the coast of Savannah, GA. There are a plethora of land and water animals that call this small island, slice of paradise, home. Such as bottlenose dolphins, roseate spoonbills, fiddler and hermit crabs, as well as many other organisms. Take a ride through the sprawling narrow waterways with us as we explore this region's rich marshland beaches and lagoons! With a Bull River Marina Captain as your guide, you can expect to see unfathomed and untouched natural beauty rambling through the Georgia low country.
